hotels.title: NSW Central Coast Beachfront Escape Just 90 Minutes from Sydney with Endota Spa
hotels.description: For dazzling ocean panoramas and Miami Beach vibes, make a beeline for Crowne Plaza Terrigal Pacific, an IHG Hotel, just 90 minutes from Sydney along NSW's Central Coast. Dine at Seasalt for fresh seafood dinners and divine views of the South Pacific Ocean, while fun times await at Terrigal Beach House outdoor beer garden, where you'll get your kicks with live entertainment overlooking Terrigal Beach. For a spot of pampering, book a massage or glowing facial at the onsite Endota Spa.

hotels.title: Central Coast Beachfront Haven with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & Complimentary Parking
hotels.description: This beachfront escape epitomises coastal excellence and strikes the perfect balance between relaxed seaside vibes and upscale comfort. Whether you're planning a family retreat, romantic escape or business trip with a view, Crowne Plaza Terrigal Pacific, an IHG Hotel has got you covered. Take the weight off with your pick between the heated outdoor pool or the Pacific Ocean, and maintain a holistic wellness regime between the fully equipped fitness centre and the onsite endota spa. Foodies will be in heaven with two restaurants serving the very best of the land and sea: float through the breezy, alfresco Terrigal Beach House, or seek some class at Meribella, awarded a 2026 Chef's Hat from the Australian Good Food Guide. This coastal escape sits on one of the Central Coast's most beloved stretches of sand - Terrigal Beach. Surf, swim or simply laze about, the choice is yours. For a dash of adventure, lace up your hiking boots and tackle The Skillion lookout for jaw-dropping coastal panoramas. The charming town of Terrigal is right on your doorstep, filled with cute cafes, boutique shops and local markets galore.
